title: जब ऋषि ने राजा से राम को माँगा | रामायण भाग 4

scenes.narration: राजा ने एक ऋषि को वचन दिया — जो माँगोगे, मिलेगा। और ऋषि ने माँग लिया... उनका बेटा।
scenes.visual: the sage Vishvamitra, a tall fierce ascetic with intense eyes, long dark-and-grey matted hair and beard, a deerskin over one shoulder, rudraksha beads, holding a wooden staff, standing tall in a royal court, pointing his staff toward the throne, intense gaze, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, no border, no frame

scenes.narration: एक दिन महर्षि विश्वामित्र अयोध्या के राजदरबार में पधारे।
scenes.visual: the sage Vishvamitra, a tall fierce ascetic with intense eyes, long dark-and-grey matted hair and beard, a deerskin over one shoulder, rudraksha beads, holding a wooden staff entering a grand ancient Indian royal court with carved stone pillars, courtiers bowing, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, no border, no frame

scenes.narration: राजा दशरथ आनंद से भर उठे, और वचन दिया — आप जो चाहेंगे, वो पूरा होगा।
scenes.visual: King Dasharatha, a dignified middle-aged Indian king with a short grey beard and moustache, ornate golden crown, gold jewellery, rich saffron and white royal garments rising from his golden throne with folded hands, joyful and welcoming, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, no border, no frame

scenes.narration: मारीच और सुबाहु नाम के दो राक्षस उनके यज्ञ को अपवित्र कर रहे थे। उसकी रक्षा के लिए उन्हें चाहिए थे श्रीराम — बस दस रातों के लिए।
scenes.visual: landscape only, no people: a small sacred fire altar burning in a forest hermitage clearing, above it a stormy night sky where dark smoke clouds form two enormous menacing fanged faces with wild hair, no wings, no bodies, drops of dark rain falling toward the altar, ancient Indian setting, vertical composition, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, full-bleed chalkboard edge to edge, no border, no frame, no white margin

scenes.narration: ये सुनते ही राजा पल भर के लिए मूर्छित हो गए। फिर बोले—
scenes.visual: close-up of King Dasharatha, a dignified middle-aged Indian king with a short grey beard and moustache, ornate golden crown, gold jewellery, rich saffron and white royal garments slumped on his throne in shock, eyes closed, a hand on his chest, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, no border, no frame

scenes.narration: मेरे कमलनयन राम अभी सोलह बरस के भी नहीं हुए। मैं उन्हें राक्षसों से युद्ध के योग्य नहीं देखता।
मेरी सेना ले जाइए, उन्होंने विनती की। मुझे ले चलिए।
scenes.visual: King Dasharatha, a dignified middle-aged Indian king with a short grey beard and moustache, ornate golden crown, gold jewellery, rich saffron and white royal garments pleading with outstretched hands, a vast army of chariots and elephants drawn in faint chalk behind him, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, no border, no frame

scenes.narration: और जब उन्होंने सुना कि ये राक्षस रावण के भेजे हुए हैं, तो उनका भय और बढ़ गया।
scenes.visual: landscape only, no figures: an ominous crowned shadow with many heads looming over distant storm clouds above a forest, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, no border, no frame

scenes.narration: विश्वामित्र क्रोध से भर उठे। रघुकुल का राजा, और अपना वचन तोड़े?
scenes.visual: close-up of the sage Vishvamitra, a tall fierce ascetic with intense eyes, long dark-and-grey matted hair and beard, a deerskin over one shoulder, rudraksha beads, holding a wooden staff furious, eyes blazing, his staff raised, the court trembling, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, no border, no frame

scenes.narration: तब कुलगुरु वसिष्ठ बोले — अपना वचन निभाइए। विश्वामित्र के साथ राम सुरक्षित हैं।
scenes.visual: the royal guru Vasishtha, a calm elderly sage with a long silver beard, white robes and a white shawl, gentle wise expression placing a calm hand on the shoulder of King Dasharatha, a dignified middle-aged Indian king with a short grey beard and moustache, ornate golden crown, gold jewellery, rich saffron and white royal garments, speaking gently, royal court, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, no border, no frame

scenes.narration: तो राजा ने राम को जाने दिया। और उनके साथ चल पड़े उनके प्रिय भाई — लक्ष्मण।
scenes.visual: a teenage prince Rama about fifteen, seen from behind, long dark hair tied back, simple dhoti and sash, a bow on his shoulder and a teenage prince Lakshmana about fourteen, fair complexion, alert eyes, simple dhoti, carrying a bow and quiver walking side by side out of the palace gates behind the sage Vishvamitra, a tall fierce ascetic with intense eyes, long dark-and-grey matted hair and beard, a deerskin over one shoulder, rudraksha beads, holding a wooden staff, the king watching from the steps, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, no border, no frame

scenes.narration: सरयू के तट पर विश्वामित्र ने उन्हें दो मंत्र सिखाए — बला और अतिबला, जिनसे न कभी थकान हो, न भूख लगे।
scenes.visual: the sage Vishvamitra, a tall fierce ascetic with intense eyes, long dark-and-grey matted hair and beard, a deerskin over one shoulder, rudraksha beads, holding a wooden staff teaching mantras to a teenage prince Rama about fifteen, seen from behind, long dark hair tied back, simple dhoti and sash, a bow on his shoulder and a teenage prince Lakshmana about fourteen, fair complexion, alert eyes, simple dhoti, carrying a bow and quiver seated on a riverbank at dusk, glowing chalk symbols in the air, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, no border, no frame

scenes.narration: पर उनकी पहली परीक्षा एक घने जंगल में इंतज़ार कर रही थी — एक राक्षसी, जिसमें हज़ार हाथियों का बल था।
